_comment: Blog posts, newest first. tools/build-site.mjs builds the blog listing (blog.html) and the homepage 'From the blog' strip from this list, and works out each post's reading time from its article text. To publish a post: add its page under blog/, then add an entry here and run npm run build:site. cover is optional: an image shown on a navy panel (logo) or filling the panel (photo, 1200x630).

posts.title: Offline first: health software for institutions where the connection fails
posts.summary: What offline first design actually involves, and who owns and protects the data once it sits on a device.
